description: The workspace's brand, as the Brand page shows it: each colour role with its light and dark mode colour (darkSameAsLight when dark mode uses the light one), the fonts (each by the role set_brand takes), the logos (links open signed in to CodeGene), the voice, and the version set_brand needs. hasBrand false means none is set up yet. The voice is the workspace's brand voice in Knowledge: change it with the knowledge tools.

workspace_id.description: Workspace id from whoami; omit when there is one.
